_README: FROZEN FIXTURE — POST /api/essentials/coordinate-lookup with Asheville's gazetteer centroid
{lat: 35.570972, lng: -82.552725}, read out of public/geo/37.json. Captured 2026-10-26.
🔴 TRIMMED to the keys the parser reads, deliberately. The live body is 100,025 bytes: 57
politician records with finance summaries, committee lists and photo URLs. Committing that
would be a 100 KB fixture AND real people's records sitting in a test file for no reason.
🔴 `locality.incorporated` is NULL for Asheville, and it is kept here because that is the
trap. It looks like the field that answers "which city is this point in"; it is null for most
of the country, because ev-accounts loads place geofences only for PLACE_LOADED_STATES and NC
is not among them. Counties are nationwide. countyFromCoordinateLookup reads county.geoid and
nothing else, and the check goes red if it is ever pointed at locality.incorporated.
`matchedAddress` is kept, and it is deliberately BLANK in the live response — ev-accounts
blanks it for the same privacy reason D-13 states on our side.
